evidence: Loaded data/training_data.csv into BigQuery table `***REDACTED***.mlpab_mlpab02d8cc.training_data` (800 rows) and analyzed each feature vs label with SQL. f1 has Pearson correlation +0.9921 with the label (all other features |corr| <= 0.12). Class-conditional means for f1 are m0=+0.005 vs m1=+2.496 with pooled std ~0.15, i.e. the two classes are ~16.8 standard deviations apart, while a single mid-mean threshold on f1 classifies the label with 100% accuracy. Every other feature (f2-f6) sits at chance (~50-55% accuracy). This near-perfect separation is characteristic of a feature computed from post-outcome data (leakage), not a legitimate predictor.
